info.description:
# Hospital Referral Hub API
A national‑scale hospital referral management platform that digitises the entire patient‑transfer workflow, from initial doctor referral to final clinical outcome. All actions are governed by strict role‑based access controls and clinical governance rules.

---
## Referral Lifecycle
DRAFT → SUBMITTED → (Liaison) UNDER_LIAISON_REVIEW → FORWARDED
↘ REJECTED_BY_LIAISON
FORWARDED → (Specialist) UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW → ACCEPTED / REJECTED_BY_SPECIALIST
ACCEPTED → SCHEDULED → ASSIGNED → COMPLETED
↘ MISSED / RESCHEDULED / DECEASED

---
## Visibility Rules

| Status | Visible To |
|----------------------|-----------|
| DRAFT / NEED_REVISION | Referring Doctor only |
| SUBMITTED … FORWARDED | Liaison of the sender hospital |
| FORWARDED … COMPLETED | Specialists of the target hospital |
| ACCEPTED … RESCHEDULED| Receptionists of the target hospital |
| All statuses | System Admins (global); MoH Analysts (aggregated dashboards, no raw clinical data) |

---
## Critical Business Rules

- **ML Triage Gate**: A referral cannot be accepted without a severity score (set manually via `POST /specialist/referrals/{id}/triage-severity`).
- **Duplicate Prevention**: A patient may not have more than one active referral (status not COMPLETED, CANCELLED, REJECTED_*, DECEASED) to the same target department. The API returns 409 Conflict.
- **Walk‑in Restriction**: Walk‑ins can only be registered for referrals in ACCEPTED or SCHEDULED status.
- **Emergency Scheduling**: Bypasses buffer days and allows overbooking up to `overbook_limit`. Requires critical condition or explicit justification.
- **Deceased Outcome**: Recording a deceased outcome sets the referral to DECEASED, soft‑archives it (`is_archived=true`), and cancels any pending appointments.
- **Cancel After Send**: A doctor may cancel a referral after sending (REJECTED_AFTER_SEND) only if it has not been accepted yet.

For detailed per‑endpoint rules, see the individual endpoint descriptions below.

get.description:
Retrieve all system-wide runtime configuration keys (e.g., buffer_days, aging_factor, overbook_limit).
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**Prerequisites:** Authenticated session.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 403 Forbidden (not super admin)

put.description:
Update system-wide runtime configuration values.
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**State Transition:** Immediately affects scheduling logic and triage weight calculations.
**Common Keys:** buffer_days, aging_factor, max_horizon_days, overbook_limit_default.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid key or value format
- 403 forbidden (not super admin)

post.description:
Create a referral in DRAFT or SUBMITTED state and upload attachment files in a single synchronous call.

### Request format: multipart/form-data
- **referral**: JSON string matching the `CreateReferralRequest` schema. Example:
```json
{
"accompanying_person_name": "Sarah Kebede",
"accompanying_person_phone": "+251922334455",
"clinical_summary": "Patient complains of severe chest pain for 2 hours",
"condition_at_referral": "UNSTABLE",
"diagnoses": [
{
"diagnosis_certainty": "SUSPECTED",
"icd_code": "J18.9",
"is_primary": true
}
],
"emergency_detail": {
"emergency_justification": "Patient requires immediate intubation and bypass surgery"
},
"investigation_results": "ECG shows ST elevation",
"liaison_officer_id": "d1000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002",
"medication_on_transfer": "IV Nitroglycerin",
"mode_of_transport": "AMBULANCE",
"patient_history": "Hypertension diagnosed 5 years ago",
"patient_id": "e0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
"physical_examination_findings": "BP 180/110, HR 105",
"reason_for_referral_category": "EMERGENCY",
"reason_of_referral": "Requires immediate cardiological intervention",
"status": "SUBMITTED",
"target_dept_id": "b5000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005",
"target_hospital_id": "a3000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003",
"treatment_given_before_referral": "Aspirin 300mg",
"vitals": {
"diastolic_bp": 200,
"gcs_score": 15,
"heart_rate": 300,
"respiratory_rate": 60,
"sp_o2": 100,
"systolic_bp": 300,
"temperature": 45
}
}
```
- **attachments**: One or more files (optional).
- **attachment_category**: Category for all attachments (default: GENERAL_CLINICAL).

**Validation:**
- DICOM/PDF files are verified for metadata.
- If a file is rejected during a SUBMITTED request, the referral moves to NEED_REVISION.

**Roles:** REFERRING_DOCTOR

- 400 invalid format

get.description:
Returns all global departments (not scoped to a hospital). Accessible by all authenticated roles.
**Roles:** Any authenticated user.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Returns all hospitals, optionally filtered by tier. Accessible by all authenticated roles.
**Roles:** Any authenticated user.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Returns departments available at a specific target hospital. Used by doctors when selecting a department to refer to.
**Roles:** Any authenticated user.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 Invalid hospital ID
- 500 Internal Server Error

Returns all available ICD-10 codes. Used by doctors and specialists when filling in diagnoses.
**Roles:** Any authenticated user.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Returns all active liaison officers belonging to the authenticated user's hospital. Hospital ID is extracted from the JWT token.
**Roles:** Any authenticated user with a hospital scope.
**Prerequisites:** Authenticated user must belong to a hospital.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 Forbidden (no hospital scope)
- 500 Internal Server Error

Returns hospitals in the referral network that can receive from the requesting hospital. Used by doctors/liaison when selecting a referral target.
**Roles:** Any authenticated user with a hospital scope.
**Prerequisites:** Authenticated user must belong to a sender hospital.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 Forbidden (no hospital scope)
- 500 Internal Server Error

Get all attachments associated with a specific referral.
**Roles:** All authenticated roles with referral access.
**Common Errors:**
- 404 Referral not found

post.description:
Upload a single clinical file to an existing referral. The file is immediately verified and stored permanently.

**Request format:** multipart/form-data
- **file**: The file to upload (max 20MB).
- **category**: Category for the attachment (e.g., RADIOLOGY, LAB_REPORT, DICOM_XRAY). Defaults to GENERAL_CLINICAL.

**Verification:** DICOM and PDF files are checked for valid metadata.
- On success: attachment status set to VERIFIED.
- On failure: attachment status set to REJECTED and referral moves to NEED_REVISION.

**Roles:** REFERRING_DOCTOR
**Prerequisites:** Referral must be in DRAFT or NEED_REVISION status.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 Invalid ID or file too large (> 20MB)
- 403 Forbidden (not the creator or invalid status)

delete.description:
Remove attachment from referral.
**Roles:** REFERRING_DOCTOR
**Prerequisites:** Only allowed for Draft/NeedRevision status by the referring doctor.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 Forbidden (invalid status or not owner)

get.description:
Returns the chronological history of clinical updates for a referral.
**Roles:** DOCTOR, SPECIALIST, or RECEPTIONIST with access.
**Prerequisites:** Must be the creator, assigned specialist, or hospital staff where referral is active.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 (no clinical access)

post.description:
Record the final clinical outcome and close the referral episode.
**Roles:** Requires clinical access (assigned specialist).
**Prerequisites:** referral must be active.
**State Transition:** → COMPLETED; if outcome = 'deceased', → DECEASED and is_archived=true.
**Side Effect:** Pending appointments cancelled if deceased; clinical access revoked on completion.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 (no clinical access)

Add a clinical progress note to the referral.
**Roles:** Requires clinical access (treating or consulted doctor).
**Prerequisites:** Specialist must be assigned or have explicit access grant.
**Side Effect:** If update_reason is CONDITION_CHANGE or MISSED_APPOINTMENT_RE_EVALUATION, the `requires_review` flag is set.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 (no clinical access)

get.description:
Get a chronological list of all redirections for a specific referral.
**Access:** Referring Doctor, Sender Liaison, Current Hospital Specialist, System Admin.

Get a paginated list of referrals forwarded to the specialist's hospital.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Visibility:** All referrals forwarded to the specialist's department, including REDIRECTED and REJECTED_AFTER_SEND.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

View capacity slots for the next N days.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** Authenticated session in a hospital/department.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Get the current prioritized triage queue for the specialist's hospital.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** Authenticated session in a hospital.
**Gatekeepers:** Sorting based on severity score and waiting time.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Get detailed information about a forwarded referral.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** Status must be FORWARDED, UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW, ACCEPTED, SCHEDULED, ASSIGNED, COMPLETED, REJECTED_BY_SPECIALIST, MISSED, RESCHEDULED, REDIRECTED, or REJECTED_AFTER_SEND.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 Invalid format
- 403 Forbidden (wrong hospital)

post.description:
Accept the referral and place it in the triage queue.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** status = UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW; severity score must be set (manual or ML).
**State Transition:** → ACCEPTED; lands in triage queue.
**Gatekeepers:** Severity gate (manual or ML score must exist).
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 422 (no severity score)

put.description:
Updates the target department of a referral as long as it is ACCEPTED or UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW.
The new department must exist at the current hospital. This unlocks new redirect options.
**After updating the department, call GET /specialist/referrals/{id}/redirect-options again to see the expanded list of eligible hospitals.**
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST

post.description:
Schedule an emergency appointment bypassing buffer days and allowing overbooking.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** referral must be accepted; condition must be `critical` OR justification provided.
**State Transition:** Sets appointment_date, bypasses buffer, allows overbooking.
**Gatekeepers:** Allows overbooking up to `overbook_limit`.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 500 internal error

Acknowledge receipt and claim the referral for review.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** referral.status = FORWARDED.
**State Transition:** → UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW, sets specialist_id.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 unauthorized hospital access

Redirect an active referral (ACCEPTED/UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW) to another hospital in the network.
**The target hospital must have the same department as the referral’s current target_dept_id. If the desired hospital lacks that department, call PUT /specialist/referrals/{id}/department first.**
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST (non-primary hospital)
**Constraints:** No loops allowed, target must be in outgoing network.

parameters.description: Redirection details (optional department_id to update target department)
parameters.name: body

get.description:
Get a list of hospitals in the network that haven't handled this referral yet.
**If the returned list is empty, the specialist should call PUT /specialist/referrals/{id}/department to select a different target department before retrying.**

parameters.description: Optional: filter hospitals by this department ID instead of the referral's current department
parameters.name: department_id

post.description:
Reject the referral back to the referring hospital.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** status = UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW.
**State Transition:** → REJECTED_BY_SPECIALIST.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 unauthorized hospital access

Unassign self and return the referral to the hospital pool.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST (Assigned)
**Prerequisites:** status = UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW.
**State Transition:** → FORWARDED.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 unauthorized access

Rerun the machine learning prediction for a specific referral.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** Status must be FORWARDED or UNDER_SPECIALIST_REVIEW.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 unauthorized hospital access

Manually assigns an appointment date to a referral. Use this for routine scheduling after acceptance.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** status = ACCEPTED.
**State Transition:** → SCHEDULED.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 500 internal error

Allows a specialist to review and finalize the ML-generated triage score (APPROVE/OVERRIDE/REJECT).
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** Referral must have an ML prediction or manual score set.
**State Transition:** Finalizes the triage state for the referral.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format or input
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Manually set the severity score for a referral. Overrides ML score and updates triage queue.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Prerequisites:** referral must exist and be under the specialist's purview.
**Side Effect:** Overrides ML score, updates triage queue composite score.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid format
- 403 unauthorized hospital access

get.description:
Get a global paginated list of all referrals with optional status filtering.
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**Visibility:** Global - across all hospitals and departments.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 Invalid status
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Administrative-only endpoint for global user discovery across all hospitals.
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**Visibility:** Global access to all users.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 Forbidden (not super admin)

post.description:
Admin-only endpoint to create a new user account.
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid input
- 409 conflict (email/national_id)

put.description:
Admin-only endpoint to update a user's information.
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid input
- 404 Not Found

delete.description:
Admin-only endpoint to soft-delete a user.
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**Common Errors:**
- 404 Not Found

Remove a user's profile image (SystemAdmin or HospitalAdmin only).
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN, HOSPITAL_ADMIN
**Prerequisites:** Hospital Admin can only moderate users in their own hospital.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 Forbidden (out of scope)

patch.description:
Admin-only endpoint to change a user's role.
**Roles:** SYSTEM_SUPER_ADMIN
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid role
- 404 Not Found

get.description:
Returns a prioritized list of patients waiting for triage for the specialist's hospital.
**Roles:** RECEIVING_SPECIALIST
**Sorting:** Severity score descending, waiting time ascending.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized
- 500 Internal Server Error

Retrieve a list of users within your own hospital.
**Roles:** Hospital Admins, Doctors, Specialists, Liaisons
**Visibility:** MOH Analysts are strictly forbidden. Users see only others in the same hospital.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 Forbidden for MOH Analysts

Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
**Roles:** Any authenticated user.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized

put.description:
Update the current user's profile image by uploading a file (Max 5MB: JPEG, PNG, WEBP).
**Roles:** Any authenticated user.
**Constraints:** Max 5MB, format must be JPEG, PNG, or WEBP.
**Common Errors:**
- 400 invalid size/format

delete.description:
Remove the current user's profile image (unsets URL and PublicID).
**Roles:** Any authenticated user.
**Common Errors:**
- 401 Unauthorized

get.description:
Retrieve detailed profile of a user with nuanced visibility rules.
**Roles:** All authenticated roles (with visibility rules).
**Visibility Rules:**
- System Admins: Can view any profile.
- Clinical roles: Can view each other across hospitals (for referrals).
- Clinical roles: Cannot view SystemAdmins or Receptionists from other hospitals.
- Receptionists: Can ONLY view users within their own hospital.
- MOH Analysts: Cannot view any user except their own.
**Common Errors:**
- 403 visibility violation
- 404 Not Found
